_about: Every photo the site shows. One record, one caption, one credit, used on every page (home collage, Story, /photos/, /people/ photo credits, EPK), so credits can never disagree. credit: a name shown as 'Photo: Name', or null (taken by the band, family or a self-timer: no credit line, P17). A photographer whose credit is single-source or awaiting confirmation is not used until it is confirmed (status 'pending'). The Amy Wilstermann 2003 shoot is credited from 2026-11-06 (LL-45): credit line only. 'collage': the photo's slot in the home collage (LL-32). 'cutout': a transparent cut-out of the same photo for the roundel 'jump' (design C); it carries the photo's own caption and credit. 'src' is relative to the repository root. Era groups: 1997-2000, 2001-2004, 2005-2007, 2008-.
